title: GitHub Profile Viewer
description: Build a GitHub profile viewer that displays user profiles and repository lists from mock data.

steps.title: Profile data structure
steps.description: Create a profile object with `username`, `name`, `avatarUrl`, `bio`, `publicRepos`, `followers`, and `following` properties.
hints: avatarUrl can be a placeholder like 'https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/1'
publicRepos, followers, following should be numbers
bio is a short string description

verification.failureMessage: Include username, name, avatarUrl, bio, publicRepos, followers, and following.

steps.title: getProfile function
steps.description: Write `getProfile(username)` that returns a mock profile object for a given username. Use a predefined object, or return `null` if not found.
hints: Create a mockProfiles object keyed by username

verification.failureMessage: Return the profile for existing users and null for unknown.

steps.title: renderProfile function
steps.description: Write `renderProfile(profile)` that returns a formatted HTML string showing the profile's name, bio, and stats (repos, followers, following).
hints: Return empty string if profile is null
Use template literals to build HTML
Show stats as a list or divs

verification.failureMessage: Return HTML with name, bio, and stats.

steps.title: getRepos function
steps.description: Write `getRepos(username)` that returns a mock array of repository objects with `name`, `description`, `stars`, `forks`, and `language`.
hints: Use a mockRepos object keyed by username
Each repo has name, description, stars, forks, language

verification.failureMessage: Return an array of repo objects with name, stars, forks, language.

steps.title: renderRepos function
steps.description: Write `renderRepos(repos)` that returns a formatted HTML string listing all repos with their name, description, stars, forks, and language.
hints: Return empty string if no repos
Map each repo to a list item HTML
Show stars and forks with icons or labels

verification.failureMessage: Return HTML listing all repos with their details.
